network_offline.title: No internet connection
network_offline.message: Your device appears to be offline.
network_offline.solution: Check your Wi-Fi or mobile data connection and try again.

connection_failed.title: Unable to connect
connection_failed.message: Could not connect to the Agentys assistant.
connection_failed.solution: Make sure the assistant is running and reachable. If the problem persists, restart the application.

timeout.title: Response timeout
timeout.message: The operation is taking longer than expected.
timeout.solution: Try again in a moment. If the problem persists, check your internet connection.

network_error.title: Network error
network_error.solution: Check your internet connection and make sure the assistant is running correctly.

auth_token_expired.title: Session expired
auth_token_expired.message: Your email account connection has expired.
auth_token_expired.solution: Sign in to your account again to continue using Agentys.

unauthorized.title: Authentication required
unauthorized.message: You must be signed in to perform this action.
unauthorized.solution: Connect your email account in settings.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.message: You do not have the required permissions for this action.
forbidden.solution: Make sure your account has sufficient rights, or contact your administrator.

oauth_revoked.title: Authorization revoked
oauth_revoked.message: Access to your email account has been revoked.
oauth_revoked.solution: Reconnect your email account to allow Agentys to access your emails again.

invalid_credentials.title: Invalid credentials
invalid_credentials.solution: Check your email address and password in the account settings.

sync_rate_limited.title: Too many requests
sync_rate_limited.message: The mail service is asking you to wait before syncing again.
sync_rate_limited.solution: Wait a few minutes before syncing your emails.

sync_conflict.title: Sync conflict
sync_conflict.message: Changes were made elsewhere during synchronization.
sync_conflict.solution: Refresh your inbox to see the latest changes.

gmail_quota_exceeded.title: Gmail limit reached
gmail_quota_exceeded.message: You have reached the daily Gmail request limit.
gmail_quota_exceeded.solution: Gmail limits the number of requests per day. Try again tomorrow or wait a few hours.

outlook_quota_exceeded.title: Outlook limit reached
outlook_quota_exceeded.message: You have reached the Microsoft request limit.
outlook_quota_exceeded.solution: Microsoft limits the number of requests. Try again in a few hours.

draft_generation_failed.title: Unable to generate draft
draft_generation_failed.message: An error occurred while generating your reply.
draft_generation_failed.solution: Try regenerating the draft. If the problem persists, adjust your instructions.

llm_unavailable.title: AI assistant unavailable
llm_unavailable.message: The AI service is not responding.
llm_unavailable.solution: Check your internet connection. If the problem persists, the service may be temporarily unavailable.

llm_timeout.title: AI assistant is taking too long
llm_timeout.message: Response generation is taking longer than expected.
llm_timeout.solution: Try with shorter instructions, or retry in a moment.

llm_rate_limited.title: AI assistant limit reached
llm_rate_limited.message: Too many requests have been sent to the AI assistant.
llm_rate_limited.solution: Wait a few minutes before generating a new draft.

send_failed.title: Send failed
send_failed.message: The email could not be sent.
send_failed.solution: Check your internet connection and email account settings, then try again.

invalid_recipient.title: Invalid recipient
invalid_recipient.message: The recipient's email address is not valid.
invalid_recipient.solution: Make sure you have entered a correct email address (example@domain.com).

email_bounced.title: Email not delivered
email_bounced.message: The email could not be delivered to the recipient.
email_bounced.solution: The address may no longer exist or the mailbox is full. Check the address and try again.

email_provider_error.title: Email service error
email_provider_error.message: Unable to communicate with the mail server.
email_provider_error.solution: Check your email account settings. If the problem persists, the mail service may be temporarily unavailable.

not_found.title: Item not found
not_found.message: The requested item does not exist or has been deleted.
not_found.solution: Refresh the list and try again.

server_error.title: Internal error
server_error.message: An internal error occurred in the application.
server_error.solution: Try again in a moment. If the problem persists, restart the application.

service_unavailable.title: Service temporarily unavailable
service_unavailable.message: The Agentys assistant is temporarily unavailable.
service_unavailable.solution: The service may be undergoing maintenance. Try again in a few minutes.

draft_creation_failed.title: Draft creation error
draft_creation_failed.message: The draft could not be created in your mailbox.
draft_creation_failed.solution: Make sure your email account is properly connected and that you have write permissions.

unknown.title: Unexpected error
unknown.solution: Try again in a moment. If the problem persists, restart the application.
